Name: Sho Metrics Linux - System Monitoring
Description: Display live System metrics such as CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery, sensor metrics, and HTTP metrics.

com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.catalog-metric.Name: Advanced Sensor
com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.catalog-metric.Tooltip: Displays one selected metric, such as LibreHardwareMonitor data.

com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.custom-metric.Name: Custom Metric
com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.custom-metric.Tooltip: Displays a metric from a custom source, such as HTTP JSON.

com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.dense-multi-met.Name: Dense Multi Metric
com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.dense-multi-met.Tooltip: Displays multiple metrics in one compact view.

com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.stacked-metric.Name: Stacked Metric
com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.stacked-metric.Tooltip: Rotates between multiple metric widgets on one key.

com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.system.Name: System & Battery
com.ez.sho-metrics-linux.system.Tooltip: Displays system and supported device battery metrics.
